title: Grateful Dead Live at Electric Theater on 1969-07-04
lineage: SBD > MC > D >CD > Soundforge pitch correction > SHN

ai_review.summary: A poorly recorded transitional ’69 show riddled with tape hiss and splices, but the Casey Jones performance stands out.
ai_review.review: The recording suffers from noticeable tape hiss, numerous cuts and splices, and a gnarly sound after “Me & My Uncle,” making most of the set difficult to enjoy. Musically it captures an early‑stage July 4, 1969 show with experimental versions of songs, yet the highlight is a lively Casey Jones that reviewers praise for its organ backdrop and Jerry’s guitar tone.

ai_rating.rationale: Two low‑star reviews focus on severe audio problems while one high‑star review praises a single song; the show is average with a notable highlight, and the recording quality is poor.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape hiss throughout, numerous cuts & splices, especially bad after “Me & My Uncle”; overall sound described as gnarly and barely listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Transitional early‑'69 set with experimental versions of songs that would later become staples; inconsistent flow due to recording issues.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone and vocals on Casey Jones are praised as sounding good despite overall poor audio.
band_member_comments.Keys: Calliope‑like organ background noted on Casey Jones.
